legend: Little time is left before Berland annual football championship. Therefore the coach of team "Losewille Rangers" decided to resume the practice, that were indefinitely interrupted for uncertain reasons. Overall there are n players in "Losewille Rangers". Each player on the team has a number — a unique integer from 1 to n. To prepare for the championship, the coach Mr. Floppe decided to spend some number of practices.

Mr. Floppe spent some long nights of his holiday planning how to conduct the practices. He came to a very complex practice system. Each practice consists of one game, all n players of the team take part in the game. The players are sorted into two teams in some way. In this case, the teams may have different numbers of players, but each team must have at least one player.

The coach wants to be sure that after the series of the practice sessions each pair of players had at least one practice, when they played in different teams. As the players' energy is limited, the coach wants to achieve the goal in the least number of practices.
Help him to schedule the practices.
input: A single input line contains integer n (2 ≤ n ≤ 1000).
output: In the first line print m — the minimum number of practices the coach will have to schedule. Then print the descriptions of the practices in m lines.

In the i-th of those lines print fi — the number of players in the first team during the i-th practice (1 ≤ fi < n), and fi numbers from 1 to n — the numbers of players in the first team. The rest of the players will play in the second team during this practice. Separate numbers on a line with spaces. Print the numbers of the players in any order. If there are multiple optimal solutions, print any of them.

legend.ai: 距离 Berland 年度足球锦标赛只剩下不多的时间。因此，"Losewille Rangers"队的教练决定恢复训练，而训练因某些不明原因被无限期地中断了。"Losewille Rangers"队共有 n 名球员。队中的每名球员都有一个编号——从 1 到 n 的互不相同的整数。为了备战锦标赛，教练 Mr. Floppe 决定进行若干次训练。
Mr. Floppe 在假期中花了好几个漫长的夜晚来规划如何进行训练。他设计出了一套非常复杂的训练方案。每次训练由一场比赛组成，队中的 n 名球员全部参加比赛。球员会以某种方式被分成两队。在这种情况下，两队的人数可以不同，但每队至少必须有一名球员。
教练希望确保在这一系列训练结束后，每一对球员都至少有过一次参加不同队伍的训练。由于球员的体力有限，教练希望用尽可能少的训练次数达到这一目标。
请帮助他安排这些训练。

input.ai: 输入仅包含一行，一个整数 n（2 ≤ n ≤ 1000）。

output.ai: 第一行输出 m——教练需要安排的训练次数的最小值。然后用 m 行输出训练的描述。
在这些行中的第 i 行输出 f_i——第 i 次训练时第一队中的球员数（1 ≤ f_i < n），以及从 1 到 n 中的 f_i 个数字——第一队中球员的编号。其余球员将在本次训练中参加第二队。用空格分隔一行中的各个数字。球员编号可以按任意顺序输出。如果存在多个最优解，输出任意一个即可。
